g.text: Delugi freshness correction: matched local processes
4 independent release processes · 100 tx/s · 2 s warmup + 10 s input · 1 useful byte/tx
Uniform: δ = 10 ms, Δ = 100 ms. Synthetic WAN-like matrix: Δ = 1,000 ms; two edges are estimates.
Origin-local proposal acceptance separates await-proposal and agreement. Panel scales differ.
